name: Short Circuit Electronics
old_description: Staunton's premier destination for car audio, window tinting, and automotive electronics. Over
about:
Short Circuit Electronics was founded in 1994 by Thomas Wright in Staunton, Virginia. The shop remains family-owned, operated by Thomas and his wife Jami Wright. Thomas, a professional sound engineer who also serves as audio engineer for Village Church in Churchville, opened the business with a simple goal: do great work and treat every customer like a neighbor.

The company provides installation, repair, and custom integration services for automotive, marine, powersports, residential, and commercial electronics. Core services include car audio system design and installation (head units, speakers, subwoofers, amplifiers), 3M window tint and security film application, remote start and alarm systems (Viper, Avital), custom LED lighting, home theater and whole-home audio, commercial audio/video for churches, restaurants, and venues, security camera and alarm systems, and general electronics repair such as wiring harness and instrument cluster diagnostics. The shop handles projects ranging from daily-driver upgrades to fleet vehicles, vintage restorations, and one-off custom builds.

Customers span individual vehicle owners, motorcycle and UTV enthusiasts, boat owners, homeowners seeking theater installations, and commercial clients including churches, restaurants, sports bars, and fleet operators. The team regularly works on cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats, UTVs, golf carts, and has experience with emergency vehicle lighting and vintage electronics restoration.

The Wrights attribute their longevity to Thomas’s professional acoustics expertise, over three decades of hands-on experience, a willingness to tackle unusual or difficult projects other shops decline, and a community-first mindset that emphasizes honest advice and quality workmanship over upselling.
